_comment: Grid machines for the inventory-factory. Offsets are [x,y] relative to the core cell. 'inputs' = cells read (set-based: a recipe matches when its needs are present across the input cells). 'outputs' = cells written (a recipe's produces are distributed across free output cells). Recipes live in recipes.json keyed by machine. 'cost' is spent from the factory on a NEW build (placing from your machine stock is free). 'locked' machines unlock when 'unlock_requires' (cumulative Mars deliveries) is met. 'world:true' would mark a room/utility station (none here — those are separate interactable scripts).

scrapper_arm.name: Scrapper Arm
scrapper_arm._note: A 5-cell machine: core + 4 typed scrap slots along the bar (copper/steel/plastic/ceramic). Harvested scrap stacks into its matching slot (cell kind 'arm_slot'). Recyclers placed so an input cell touches a slot PULL that scrap straight out (no conveyor/insert). Pre-placed and persists.

copper_recycler.name: Copper Recycler
copper_recycler._note: Broken Recyclers repair-roll into one of the 4 material recyclers (machine_finds). Data-driven; multi-material/upgradeable = more defs later.

copper_ammo_maker.name: Copper Ammo Maker
copper_ammo_maker._note: Broken Ammo Makers repair-roll into one of these 4 (one per family). Recipes are data-driven and level-gated (see recipes.json 'level').

coupling_maker.name: Coupling Maker
coupling_maker._note: Broken Component Makers repair-roll into one of these. Each combines two base materials into a component (machine type decides the output, not a universal table).

copper_weapon.name: Copper Blaster
copper_weapon._note: Found broken; repairs into a family weapon. Feed its ammo into the input slot; combat draws from there (see PlayerCombat / FactoryGrid.try_fire_weapon).

plastic_weapon.name: Resin Repeater
plastic_weapon._note: Spread: one trigger-pull fires 3 pellets in a fan (spread_deg).

ceramic_weapon.name: Ceramic Lance
ceramic_weapon._note: Pierce: the shot passes through up to 2 enemies (hits 3 in a line).

storage_cache.name: Storage Cache
storage_cache._note: A sink: items fed into its input stack up to `capacity` of ONE type. Load a full cache at the retrieval pad to ship the whole stack in one cartridge slot.
